text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The target time for the pace run is quite
demanding—
I see, to prepare for the debut race,
then.

Her debut race will be on turf at 1800
meters.
The venue will be Kyoto Racecourse.

Because the track features two corners and
a flat straight,
race times tend to be fast.
Taking those into account,
I was fine-tuning the parameters.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
—Let us begin at once.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah...!
...HaaaaaaAAH—!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, phew...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...That concludes today's menu.
Once I finish stretching,
I'll return to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Go on ahead and head home for today.
I'll be counting on you again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Taaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is that——Pisa?

Running far off across the track was Victoire
Pisa,
whose gentle gaze held a quiet,
steadfast strength.

A horse girl who values bonds and harmony
above all else,
and despises being alone.

Contrary to her gentle demeanor,
her running is exceptionally powerful.

Kicking off the ground,
streaking past in an instant—
before her running,
so incredible for someone yet to debut,
both of them found themselves struck
speechless.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Rumor had it she was moving exceptionally well,
but I never imagined it would be to that
degree.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The debut race is the first touchstone.
I have no intention of ceding victory to
her and betraying the expectations resting
upon my shoulders.

—Indeed.
Victoire Pisa was scheduled to make her
debut in the very same race as Rose
Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please raise the intensity of tomorrow's
training regimen.
And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A change of plans.
I wish to add an extra self-training session
today.
Could you advise me on the menu?

Feeling the presence of their rivals,
they raced through the days leading up to
their debut—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
For today's debut race,
the top favorite is Victoire Pisa...
And apparently a girl from the Rose Clan is
running too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Rose Clan!
You hear their name in graded stakes all
the time.
Haven't they yet to reach a G1 title,
though—?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(In a contest of pure burst,
I can surpass even Pisa.
Believing in these legs and the days that
brought me here—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —I shall be off.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Pisa...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I am glad.
I was hoping to speak with you before things
got underway.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To have our debut races coincide like this
is such a fateful coincidence, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, let us make today a wonderful day.
For me, and for you as well, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Here is to a magnificent contest.
I look forward to our match.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(All I ever thought about
was surpassing you.
'For Rose-san as well,' is it...?)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just thinking...
I really am no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Let us compete today with all our hearts
and minds.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It brings me great joy to stand beside you
for our momentous debut race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, likewise!
